reason: I want to build the protective wall, and the graded material fits the furnace mold.
expectation: The furnace will form wall blocks, perhaps after firing as with the paving.

alternatives.reason: Wrapping the water line also addresses a goal, but I want to make the wall first.

effect: The mold made blocks as expected, so I can place them around the cabin.
reaction: The interlocking blocks sound like a satisfying way to build a wall.
reason: The cabin perimeter is the natural place to assemble the blocks into a protective shell.
expectation: A freestanding wall will surround the cabin without bearing on its skin.

alternatives.reason: The water line needs shelter too, but I want to finish the wall first.

effect: The blocks form a freestanding wall, but the protection goal remains unfinished.
reaction: I am curious what the shovel adds to the wall.
reason: The offered shovel and wall combination seems the next step toward completing the cabin protection, though its exact purpose is unclear.
expectation: I guess I will bank loose material against or around the wall for insulation or stability.

alternatives.reason: I could shelter the line now, but I want to see how the wall is finished.

effect: The shovel bermed the cabin and finished the protection goal; now the line remains.
reaction: The heater cycling off and the preserved view make the benefit feel tangible.
reason: This is the only available combination and the quilt seems suited to insulating the connected line.
expectation: The line will be wrapped or insulated, sheltering its water.

effect: The line is insulated but the shelter goal needs another step.
reaction: I expected insulation alone might complete it, so I am curious about the extra shelter.
reason: The shovel and insulated line are the only combination offered and presumably finish the shelter.
expectation: I expect to bury or cover the insulated line for added protection.

effect: The shovel placed the insulated line in a service trench and completed the remaining goal.
reaction: That matches my expectation; the result is clear but brief.

mostWorthwhile.text: Berming the wall was most worthwhile: the heater cycling off and the window view made the improvement feel real.

leastWorthwhile.text: Insulating and then trenching the line felt a little procedural; the final result gave little sense of the benefit.

surprise.text: I thought insulating the line might satisfy the shelter goal, but it also needed the trench.

arbitrary.text: The shovel and freestanding wall pairing was not fully clear before trying it, though the resulting berm made sense.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue: making a useful shelter was satisfying, and I would be curious to see what happens next, though this chapter had few consequential choices.
